articles.title: A Record Number of Black Candidates Are Running for Governor This Year
articles.summary: Only three Black people have ever been elected governor in U.S. history. This year, eight Black candidates are running—the most ever. They come from both parties and many states.

articles.title: A Train Crash in England May Have Been Caused by a Bumpy Track
articles.summary: A train derailed near Lewes, England, hurting 30 people. Investigators found a defect in the track. The hot weather may have made the ground shift under the rails.

articles.title: North Korea Says Smaller U.S. Drills Still Feel Threatening
articles.summary: The U.S. and South Korea made their military drills smaller. But North Korea's leader's sister said it doesn't change anything—they still see the drills as hostile. She also said there are no talks between Trump and Kim Jong Un.
